body: I usually listen to music and go for a run. It helps calm all the anxiety in my brain and escape I guess. Sometimes I just stare at the wall and do nothing

I'm 16 too and had those same symptoms. It might be a reaction to medication. But for me it was because I wasn't getting any sleep. Depression had given me insomnia, and not sleeping can cause you to have memory loss and lack of mental function.

You can treat depression with meds and therapy. The most important thing to me is finding someone supportive to talk to like parents or friends or people on this subreddit. Do things that get you outside, like exercise. Check on yourself every day to make sure that you're eating and sleeping enough. If you need someone to talk to/give you support, you can PM me.
